title: Geopolitical Parallax: Beyond Walter Lippmann Just After Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing article-level embeddings and downstream news quality classification scores (e.g., subjectivity, emotion, fluency) between Chinese-origin and Western-origin language models evaluating politically sensitive topics (Palestine, China, US). It also uses counterfactual country name substitution in generated synthetic news prompts to probe model behavior across different geopolitical targets.

Using logistic regression probes trained on sentence embeddings to quantify per-metric differences (parallax deltas) between model families in predicting news quality dimensions such as semantic subjectivity, emotional tone, and relational qualities in journalistic text.
